issue: The original one-stage prospective sealer could record holdings and economics only after the weekly exit, so the tool itself did not independently prove that the ranking and holdings had been sealed before entry.
correction: Replace the one-stage evidence seal with an append-only staged chain: V16B_SIGNAL_SEAL -> V16B_ENTRY_SEAL -> V16B_RESULT_SEAL -> EXTERNAL_DELTA_ATTACHMENT.

evidence_contract.signal_stage: After Thursday UTC close and before Friday UTC close: seal source hashes, CMC snapshot availability, feature-panel hash, model state, full eligible score map, deterministic full score ranking and preliminary top-10 longs.
evidence_contract.entry_stage: Before Friday UTC close: reference the signal seal; preserve longs; walk the frozen ranking bottom-up using causal shortability evidence; seal the first 10 verifiably shortable names, instruments, exposure, trailing volatility, turnover estimate and frozen 15 bps cost assumption.
evidence_contract.result_stage: Only after the following Friday UTC close: reference the entry seal; persist execution/source hashes and per-asset entry/exit prices, raw returns, frozen weights, weighted PnL, long/short leg totals, actual funding, transaction cost, net PnL and BTC benchmark.
evidence_contract.external_delta_stage: External Delta may be attached only after the self result is sealed and can never alter the sealed self evidence.

anti_discretion_invariants: full eligible ranking is sealed at signal time
longs are exactly the frozen top 10 and cannot change at entry
shortability checks must follow frozen bottom-up ranking order
shorts are exactly the first 10 causally shortable assets encountered
shortability checking stops when the 10th short is found
selected longs require predeclared executability evidence and cannot be replaced after ranking
per-asset result rows must exactly match the 20 sealed entry holdings and instruments
per-asset weights are recomputed from frozen 0.05 times exposure
cost is recomputed from frozen 15 bps times sealed turnover
net PnL and BTC benchmark return are recomputed from sealed components
justification_for_same_candidate_id: The amendment only strengthens pre-outcome evidence timing before the first eligible prospective signal; it does not change any economic decision rule and prospective_count was zero.
